verdict.rationale: Gecko, a SaaS security scanner (not itself an agent), documents an official MCP server on its AI-tools page. Connected AI tools can list repositories and scans, pull vulnerability evidence (PoC, call chain, patch diff), triage findings, and file tickets. missing for 10: details on setup, authentication and transport for the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect it to an AI tool and the tool can list your repositories and scans, pull full vulnerability evidence (proof of concept, call chain, patch diff), triage findings, and file tickets.
